ai_review.summary: Killer '82 summer tour audience recording with high‑energy performance, tempered by minor recording flaws.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the show’s killer energy and deem this Exec. Crew audience tape one of the best sources from the ’82 summer run, despite noting some inevitable recording imperfections. The sound captures the excitement well enough that listeners prefer it to later archival mixes.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance (high energy, praised by both reviewers) combined with a good‑ish audience recording that has some flaws; limited number of short reviews yields moderate confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and lively, but reviewers mention inevitable audience‑tape issues and occasional flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; overall impression is that the show flows well and maintains high excitement.
